verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents a comprehensive Admin REST API (kc-docs-6, kc-supp-kcadm) that the kcadm CLI wraps, and the same operations (realms, users, roles, clients, permissions) are said to be available via API as via the Admin Console — strong first-party support for API-as-UI-parity. However, a hands-on report notes the API is 'inconsistent' and hard to use idempotently for automation (keycloak-comm-13), SCIM explicitly excludes protected admin resources ('never through SCIM', kc-supp-scim), and no discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable spec was found (keycloak-probe-3), undermining full AI-native parity and discoverability. missing for 10: independent corroboration that all UI-only workflows (e.g. theme customization, some fine-grained authz UI flows) have equal API parity, a public/discoverable OpenAPI spec, and resolution of reported API inconsistency for automation.
